metadata.scope: Root-fix Issue #1190 (/me 5xx) re-optimized against current code (HEAD 52ade3866, 2026-06-12). The original deferred_pending_root_cause blocker (cannot start until H4 is confirmed on staging) is dissolved by this workflow's static audit: the 5xx-generating paths are now concretely identified (P1-P8 map in _shared-context.md). The global onError errorHandler (UBM-5000 problem+json + structured logError) already exists, so the remaining root problems are (F-1) fail-soft inconsistency in GET /me/profile where getPendingRequestsForMember alone is fail-hard and turns a secondary-data D1 exception into a whole-page 500 while photoUrl/editResponseUrl already degrade, (F-2) primary-data D1 exceptions in sessionGuard and buildMemberProfile collapse into generic UBM-5000 making the failing scope unidentifiable although UBM-5001 (Database Error) is already defined, and (F-3) no contract tests pin the 5xx shape or the fail-soft behavior. Tasks T01 (fail-soft unification, 200 preserved), T02 (ApiError UBM-5001 + context.scope classification, status taxonomy unchanged), T03 (D1-exception-injection contract tests in index.contract.spec.ts), T04 (Issue #1190 modernization draft, GitHub mutation user-gated). No /me path/shape/status change, no D1 schema change, no new endpoint, apps/web untouched. Implemented locally in this cycle: T01-T03 code, focused D1 contract tests, API typecheck, and API lint are complete. Commit, push, PR, staging, and any GitHub issue mutation remain user-gated.
